caption: The drawing depicts two views of a carved figurine resembling a woman in classical attire, shown from the side on the left and from the front on the right. The figurine is colored in various shades of brown, with touches of golden yellow to accentuate depth, contours, and details. The woman is depicted standing on a round base, wearing a long, pleated, and flowing garment that covers her legs and feet. She has a headdress or helmet with a crest and wears what appears to be classical armor, including a breastplate. Her arms are positioned differently from each view; in the side view, her left arm is bent, resting on her garment, while in the front view, both arms are crossed over her chest. By her side in the front view, there is a round, vertically positioned object resembling a shield with some inscribed patterns or text. The background is a plain off-white or light beige, and there is a small inscription in the lower right corner that reads "L. S. Markinson – K.C., M.O."
title: Indian Bottle (Medicine Bottle)
